source_text: Et dixit Deus: Fiat firmamentum in medio aquae. Cum iam antea Deus fecisset coelum, nunc firmamentum facit, id est corporeum coelum. Omne enim corpus firmum est et solidum. Primum coelum, spiritalis substantia, est mens nostra, spiritalis homo qui videt Deum. Firmamentum, corporale coelum, exterior homo est. Si dividere potuerit aquas superiores et inferiores, etiam ipse caelestis homo appellabitur: Nostra autem conversatio in caelis est.
pass_a_gloss: And said God: Let-be firmament in middle of-water. When already before God had-made heaven, now firmament he-makes, that is bodily heaven. Every for body firm is and solid. First heaven, spiritual substance, is mind our, spiritual human who sees God. Firmament, bodily heaven, outer human is. If to-divide he-will-have-been-able waters upper and lower, also himself heavenly human will-be-called: Our however citizenship in heavens is.
pass_b_english: [[God said: Let there be a firmament in the midst of the water >> Bible:Genesis 1:6]]. Though God had already made heaven, he now makes the firmament — that is, the bodily heaven. For every body is firm and solid. The first heaven, spiritual substance, is our mind, the spiritual human who sees God. The firmament, the bodily heaven, is our outer human. If one can divide the upper waters from the lower, that one too will be called a heavenly human: [[Our citizenship is in heaven >> Bible:Philippians 3:20]].
